definition.title: Write a practical message
definition.subtitle: Two places with similar names · 2 · preparation 1
definition.context: Use this subset of the travel vocabulary and constructions in a short self-contained situation, preparing for U6-18. Use the selected vocabulary and constructions to resolve a location misunderstanding using precise reference.

questions.prompt: Two places with similar names · 2 · preparation 1: Write a synthesis for an absent participant. Attribute the earlier and later source statements, explain how they affect the conclusion, and distinguish your interpretation from what the source establishes.
questions.context:
朋友让我到码头附近的一家旧书店见面，发来一个定位。我照着走，到达以后却只看见一堵墙，手机说已经到了，眼前却没有可以进去的门。

我没有继续沿墙乱找，而是告诉朋友自己看到的情况。原来定位指向整座建筑，书店的入口在另一侧，需要从旁边的街头走过去。

朋友发来一张门口照片，又说明会经过什么店。我把地图上的点和实际能看见的东西结合起来，很快找到路，没有因为已经抵达附近就认为任务完成。

进门以后，店里的人说很多第一次来的客人遇到同样问题。他们准备在网上介绍里补充入口说明，不只留下一个看起来很准确的点。

我们离开时，另一位客人正在墙外看手机。我指给他看入口的方向，也提醒他先注意路上的车辆，不必一直低着头看着画面。

回家后，朋友把新的说明存好。下次邀请别人时，他仍然会发定位，不过会再问一句，你现在能看见门吗？地图里的抵达，和真正走进去之间还有一步。
questions.label: Write your own message

rubric.text: I attributed the source statements and preserved their qualifications.
My interpretation is clearly separated from established information and does not erase uncertainty.

definition.summary: Your results distinguish checked answers from self-reviewed practice. Unsampled material and unassessed proficiency remain separate.
